Title: Q3 Marketing Campaign Kickoff — Summer Escapes
Time: Tue 14 May, 10:00–11:00
Description: Walk through the creative and media plan for the Summer Escapes push. Admin note: please send any last-minute deck changes to Priya by EOD Monday so we can merge them before the meeting.

intent.requested_action: send deck changes to Priya by EOD Monday

items.text:
Title: Supplier invoice review — Coastal Tours Ltd
Time: Wed 22 May, 15:30–16:00
Description: We need to go through the March invoice from Coastal Tours immediately, since the rates look off against the contract. Finance says the system flagged two line items for re-check.

Title: Budget forecast workshop — FY25 travel volumes
Time: Thu 6 June, 09:00–11:00
Description: This workshop is where we lock the FY25 forecast for travel booking volumes across all three channels. Last year's model underestimated package-holiday demand by roughly 18% between May and August, and we can't repeat that. Marta will bring the updated seasonality curves, and Tomás has the supplier-cost assumptions from the renegotiated rate cards.

Please come prepared to defend your channel numbers. We'll work through bookings, average order value and cancellation rate separately, then reconcile the totals against Finance's top-down envelope. If the two don't meet, we decide on the call whether to flex marketing spend or adjust the volume targets.

One admin item: the room booking at Harbour House needs a confirmed headcount by Friday noon, so RSVP even if you're only dialling in. The automated room tool will release the space if nobody confirms. Parking is limited, so carpool or take the shuttle from the station.

Finally, a small reminder that the forecast feeds directly into the board pack, so keep side conversations to a minimum once we're in the numbers.

intent.requested_action: attend the budget forecast workshop and RSVP by Friday noon

Title: Invoice approval — Meridian Hotel Group
Time: Fri 31 May, 11:00–11:15
Description: Quick catch-up to approve the Meridian invoice before month-end; ignore the duplicate copy in the shared drive, it was already voided by their billing team.

intent.requested_action: approve the Meridian invoice and disregard the duplicate

items.text:
Title: Summer Escapes campaign — creative review round 2
Time: Mon 20 May, 14:00–15:30
Description: Round 2 of creative review for the Summer Escapes campaign. We'll look at the three lead concepts from Ardent Studio — the coastal reel, the city-break carousel and the family bundle hero — and pick the two we take into production.

The brief from the brand team is unchanged: lead with flexibility messaging, keep the price point visible, and don't overuse the "book now" urgency. Lena will screen the cutdowns. Bring your scores against the rubric in the shared sheet before we start; we're going to consolidate them live so the studio has direction by Wednesday.

One process note — the media plan still shows the old audience segments from the spring test. Marketing ops is re-running the segmentation, and their automated tool will publish the refreshed audiences on Tuesday, so treat Monday's numbers as indicative only. If anyone has questions about the budget line for paid social, catch me before the meeting rather than in the room.

We'll finish with a short list of next steps and owners. No need to prepare slides, but do flag any concerns about the claims in the family bundle copy in advance of the session.

intent.requested_action: review creative concepts and submit scores

items.text:
Title: Supplier invoice reconciliation — Q2 partners
Time: Tue 28 May, 13:00–14:30
Description: This session is about reconciling the Q2 supplier invoices from our top five accommodation partners. We've had three disputed line items since April, and the finance team wants a clean position before the board update next week.

Bring the contract extract for each partner. We'll go invoice by invoice: Hotel Lumen, Nordic Stays, Blue Harbour Resorts, Casa Verde and Directbook. For each one, we check the rate matches the negotiated card, the commission is applied at the correct tier, and any extras are backed by a signed addendum. Dan will run the numbers live so we can settle disagreements in the room rather than by email chains.

Admin: the conference room has a projector but no adapter for USB-C, so bring your own if you're presenting. The system also needs everyone added as a delegate to the finance folder before Tuesday, so please accept the shared-folder invite when it lands. If there's a genuine dispute we can't resolve, we escalate to procurement immediately after the session rather than letting it drift.

We'll close with an action log — who owns each follow-up and by when. Please keep email traffic to a minimum during the call so the numbers get the attention they need.

intent.requested_action: attend the reconciliation and accept the shared-folder invite

items.text:
Title: FY25 forecast sign-off and budget lock
Time: Fri 14 June, 10:00–11:00
Description: Before we lock the FY25 budget, we need a final read on the forecast. Ana has rebuilt the volume model with the new seasonality curves, and the top-down envelope from Finance now sits within 3% of our bottom-up number — close enough to sign off if nobody objects. Please review the model tab before Friday and bring only the discrepancies that actually change the total. We won't reopen the channel assumptions unless someone has hard evidence they're wrong. The chatbot on the intranet can pull last year's actuals if you need a quick comparison, though the export it gives you still needs checking against the finance extract. Admin reminder: budget lock happens immediately after this meeting, so any line you intend to challenge needs to be raised in the room, not afterwards by email.

intent.requested_action: review the forecast model and raise discrepancies at the meeting

items.text:
Title: Campaign performance check-in
Time: Wed 5 June, 16:00–16:30
Description: Short sync on the Summer Escapes campaign metrics — impressions, click-through and conversion by audience. No prep needed; the dashboard is already live.

Title: Supplier invoice dispute — Blue Harbour Resorts
Time: Mon 3 June, 09:30–10:15
Description: Blue Harbour has reissued its May invoice with a higher commission tier than the contract allows, and we need to decide how to respond before the payment run on Friday. Finance has already flagged the discrepancy, and procurement has the original rate card on file. We'll confirm the correct tier, draft the correction email together, and agree who signs off the revised amount. The automated matching tool keeps tagging the invoice as approved, so someone needs to manually override the status before it flows into the payment batch. Please come with the signed contract extract and the last three months' invoices for comparison. If we can't agree internally on the tier interpretation within the hour, we escalate to the commercial director immediately rather than let it sit until the payment run.

intent.requested_action: prepare contract extract and invoices and resolve the dispute

items.text:
Title: Budget forecast — scenario planning session
Time: Thu 20 June, 13:30–15:00
Description: This session is for scenario planning on the FY25 budget, focused on what happens if package-holiday demand comes in 10% below the base forecast. We'll run three scenarios — base, soft, and sharply down — and agree which levers we'd pull in each one. Marketing spend, paid acquisition and the supplier volume commitments are the main variables. Please look at the scenario workbook beforehand and jot down the assumptions you'd challenge. The automated sensitivity tool has already generated the first pass, but the outputs need a human read because the seasonality inputs are still provisional. One admin point: the workbook is shared view-only for now, and edit rights get switched on immediately after the session. If you need to annotate anything during the discussion, use the comment function and I'll consolidate afterwards.

intent.requested_action: review the scenario workbook and attend the session
